def parse(p):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    seps=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(inp[i]))==1]; csep=[j for j in range(w) if len({inp[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    brw=[(prev+1,s-1) for prev,s in zip([-1]+seps,seps+[h])]; bcols=[(prev+1,s-1) for prev,s in zip([-1]+csep,csep+[w])]
    bg=max(v for r_ in inp for v in r_); sepv=inp[seps[0]][0]
    colors=set(v for r_ in inp for v in r_)-{bg,sepv}; mk=list(colors)[0]
    tbl=[]
    for a,b in brw:
        row=[]
        for c,d in bcols:
            s=set((i-a,j-c) for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if inp[i][j]==mk)
            row.append((s,len(s)))
        tbl.append(row)
    return tbl,out
for p in ['1','2','3']:

            exp = out[i][j]
            if pred!=exp: ok=False; print('mismatch',i,j,pred,exp)
    print(' H1 (transposed set-eq):',ok)

steps.input:
def analyze(p):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    (br,bc),seps,csep=blocks_(inp)
    cnts=Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_)
    bg=max(cnts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[0]
    sepv=inp[list(seps)[0]][0]
    mk=[v for v in cnts if v not in (bg,sepv)][0]
    B=[]
    for a,b in br:
        row=[]
        for c,d in bc:
            pts=[(i-a,j-c) for i in range(a,b) for j in range(c,d) if inp[i][j]==mk]
            row.append(pts)
        B.append(row)
    H=len(br); W=len(bc)
    marks=set((i,j) for i,row in enumerate(out) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=1)
    # candidate sets: single marker p placed at block cell with ± sign; also shape size>1 blocks? print details first
    return B,H,W,marks
for p in ['1','2','3']:
    B,H,W,marks=analyze(p)
    print('pair',p,'H,W=',H,W,'marks:',marks)
    for bi in range(H):
        for bj in range(W):
            print((bi,bj), sorted(B[bi][bj]), 'shape', len(B[bi][bj]))

import numpy as np, json
def analyze(inp):
    a=np.array(inp); H,W=a.shape
    sep=None
    for v in np.unique(a):
        if any(all(x==v for x in r) for r in a): sep=int(v); break
    rowg=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==sep for x in a[r])]
    colg=[c for c in range(W) if all(r[c]==sep for r in a)]
    rgp=[]; prev=0
    for r in rowg+[H]:
        if r>prev: rgp.append(list(range(prev,r))); prev=r+1
    cgp=[]; prev=0
    for c in colg+[W]:
        if c>prev: cgp.append(list(range(prev,c))); prev=c+1
    bg=int(np.bincount(a[a!=sep].ravel().tolist()).argmax())
    res=[]
    for rg in rgp:
        line=[]
        for cg in cgp:
            blk=a[np.ix_(rg,cg)]; hh,ww=blk.shape
            pts=[(int(p[0]),int(p[1])) for p in np.argwhere(blk!=bg)]
            dr=min(abs(r-s) for s in rowg for r in [p[0] for p in pts])
            dc=min(abs(c-s) for s in colg for c in [p[1] for p in pts])
            d=min(dr,dc)
            # also: distance to separator within tile: min gap to tile border? 
            line.append((pts,d,hh,ww))
        res.append(line)
    return res
for n in ['3','4']:
    a=analyze(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print('demo',n)
    for i,row in enumerate(a):
        for j,(pts,d,h,w) in enumerate(row):
            print('  band',i,'tile',j,'noise',pts,'dist_sep',d,'exp',e[i][j])

import numpy as np, os, re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def analyze(inp):
    a=np.array(inp); H,W=a.shape
    sep=None
    for v in np.unique(a):
        if any(all(x==v for x in r) for r in a): sep=int(v); break
    rowg=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==sep for x in a[r])]
    colg=[c for c in range(W) if all(r[c]==sep for r in a)]
    vals,counts=np.unique(a[a!=sep],return_counts=True)
    bg=int(vals[counts.argmax()])
    groups=[]; prev=-1
    for QR in [-1]+rowg+[H]:
        line=[]; prev_c=-1
        for QC in [-1]+colg+[W]:
            blk=a[np.ix_(range(prev_r:=prev+1,QR),range(prev_c+1,QC))]
            hh,ww=blk.shape
            pts=list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(blk!=bg)))
            info={'n':len(pts)}
            if pts:
                norm_=tuple(sorted((p[0]-min(qa[0] for qa in pts),p[1]-min(qb[1] for qb in pts)) for p in pts))
                info['norm']=norm_
            line.append(info); prev=QC
        groups.append(line)
    return sep,bg,groups
T=analyze(G['Test input']); print(T)
E=G['Test input']
# verify demos
for n in ['3','4']:
    sep,bg,g=analyze(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); E=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    pred=[[3-t['n'] if t['n'] else None for t in rg] for rg in g]
    print(n, 'demo match:', pred==E)
pred=[[3-t['n'] for t in rg] for rg in T]

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
